info.title: Hudson local agent API
info.description: Preview API for a loopback-only, single-identity host. Paths are currently unversioned and compatibility is not promised. Agent configuration is loaded at startup; this API does not publish agents or manage credentials. All timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Model and tool execution is asynchronous relative to submissions. When started with --require-api-token, every route requires a persisted scoped bearer credential. Without that option this is an unprotected loopback development API. Authentication mode is a host setting, not a per-request choice. Hosted multi-tenant serving and event streaming are not implemented.

post.description: Returns after durable admission, not completion. In --catalog mode agent_ref and request_key are required; each new request key receives its own shared model budget. Other modes reject agent_ref and use the startup agent. The live OpenAPI document selects the appropriate submission schema. The request body limit is 64 KiB.
